RV-42N (RV-N cycloidal reducer) by Nabtesco

Cycloidal / Premium actuator from Nabtesco (Japan). Peak torque 2060 Nm, rated 412 Nm, weight 6300 g, torque density 327 Nm/kg, price quote only.

Notes

Nabtesco RV (Rotate Vector) two-stage cycloidal precision reducer - the gear used in the shoulder/elbow/base joints of most industrial robots (Nabtesco holds a large share of that market). This is a GEARBOX, not an integrated actuator: no motor, driver, encoder or voltage of its own (paired with a customer servomotor), hence those fields are null and integrated_driver false. RV-42N: 412 N.m rated output torque, momentary maximum (emergency-stop) torque 5x rated (~2060 N.m), available ratios up to ~185:1 (141:1 shown), <1 arcmin backlash, mass 6.3 kg, OD 159mm. Torque density is computed from momentary max torque over mass. Quote-only pricing.
